site.name: AoE2 Leagues
site.tagline: Rating-bracket leagues and tournaments for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
site.notice: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition © Microsoft Corporation. This site was created under Microsoft's <rules>Game Content Usage Rules</rules> and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Microsoft.
site.source: Rating and match data come from the game's own servers and may lag by a few minutes.

home.title: Compete with players at your level
home.subtitle: Track your rating, join a league in your bracket and play tournaments with a real shot at the podium.

add.title: Add a player
add.hint: Paste a Steam profile link, a SteamID64, an AoE2 profile_id or the exact in-game nickname.
add.free: No account needed. Anyone can add anyone.

one.title: Add
one.text: Paste a Steam link or nickname. The portal starts tracking the rating on every ladder.

two.title: Join your bracket
two.text: Leagues have rating divisions. A 900 player competes against 900 players.

three.title: Compete
three.text: Tournaments per division. Results are confirmed from the game's match history, no screenshots.

search.title: Which one is you?
search.homonyms: We found {count} profiles with the nickname "{alias}". Pick the right one by flag, rating and last match.
search.none: No profile with the exact nickname "{alias}". The search is case-sensitive and needs the full in-game name.
search.noneSteam: That Steam account has no AoE2 DE profile, or has never played online.
search.invalid: Couldn't parse that. Paste a Steam link, a numeric id or a nickname.
search.vanityFail: Couldn't resolve that Steam link. Try the /profiles/ link or the SteamID64.
search.rateLimited: Too many additions from your network in the last hour. Try again later.
search.apiDown: The game server didn't respond. Try again in a few minutes.

player.noRatings: No ranked games on any ladder.
player.noMatches: No matches recorded yet. History arrives on the first full sync.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.steamOnly: Sign-in is Steam only. We store no password or e-mail.
auth.why: Signed in, you can claim your profile, join leagues and create your own.
auth.claimDone: Profile claimed. It now shows as yours.
auth.claimNoProfile: Your Steam account has no AoE2 DE profile. Play an online game and try again.
auth.failed: Steam sign-in failed. Please try again.

me.title: My profile
me.notLogged: Sign in with Steam to see your profile.
me.noPlayer: No AoE2 profile linked to this Steam account.
